_scenario: ED CT for a kidney stone (answered). Incidental 22 mm indeterminate left adrenal nodule. ED labs show low potassium and high bicarbonate in a man whose blood pressure is uncontrolled on three drugs, which points to screening for primary aldosteronism. Hydrochlorothiazide also lowers potassium, so it is a confounder. HMO: specialist visits need a PCP referral.

1. 4 mm obstructing calculus at the right ureterovesical junction with mild right hydroureteronephrosis.

_sections.title: EXAM
_sections.text: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITHOUT CONTRAST (RENAL STONE PROTOCOL)

_sections.title: CLINICAL INDICATION
_sections.text: Acute right flank pain radiating to the groin, with hematuria. History of hypertension. Evaluate for urolithiasis.

_sections.title: TECHNIQUE
_sections.text: Helical CT of the abdomen and pelvis was performed without intravenous or oral contrast using a low-dose renal stone protocol. Coronal and sagittal reformats were reviewed. CTDIvol: 8.4 mGy. DLP: 402 mGy-cm.

items.label: Lower chest
items.text: Lung bases are clear. Heart size is normal.

items.label: Liver and biliary
items.text: Diffusely decreased hepatic attenuation consistent with steatosis. No focal lesion identified on this noncontrast exam. Gallbladder is unremarkable. No biliary dilatation.

items.label: Adrenal glands
items.text: 22 mm well-circumscribed left adrenal nodule with attenuation of 28 HU (series 2, image 41). The right adrenal gland is normal.

items.label: Kidneys, ureters, and bladder
items.text: 4 mm calculus at the right ureterovesical junction with mild right hydroureteronephrosis and mild perinephric stranding. 2 mm nonobstructing calculus in the lower pole of the left kidney. No left hydronephrosis. The bladder is partially distended and otherwise unremarkable.

items.label: Bowel and appendix
items.text: Normal appendix. No bowel obstruction or bowel wall thickening.

items.label: Lymph nodes and vessels
items.text: No lymphadenopathy. Mild atherosclerotic calcification of the abdominal aorta, which is normal in caliber.

items.label: Peritoneum
items.text: No free fluid or free air.
